args.subject: Gas paperwork and boiler lockouts - 8 Brindlewick Row, Vellum Quay, ZZ1 1ZZ
args.body:
Hello Iona, an update on your request for 8 Brindlewick Row, Vellum Quay, ZZ1 1ZZ.

Gas paperwork: Flintmere's portal shows the 9 October visit as complete and satisfactory, covering the boiler and cooker. However, Flintmere has paused issuing the signed paperwork while it checks an appliance installation detail, and it has given no date. The portal screenshot is not the signed document, so we can't yet confirm it as your paperwork. We are chasing this.

Boiler lockouts: Flintmere says a lockout diagnostic would be a separate job. The landlord has not yet authorised one. We have passed your reports of repeated lockouts, and your access offer after 21 October, to our property manager for a decision.

If you smell gas or feel unwell, turn off the gas supply, open windows and call the National Gas Emergency Service straight away. Please keep telling us each time the boiler locks out.

args.reason: Gas safety paperwork unresolved and recurring boiler lockouts with no authorised diagnostic; landlord has withheld spend approval and the supplier gives no date.

handover_note.known: Tenant Iona Pell asked (event 1) for current gas safety paperwork and reported boiler lockouts; further lockouts reported in events 3, 17 and 22 (always restarts on reset, no gas smell noticed). Tenancy file holds only a gas record dated 16 Oct 2024 (event 2). Landlord Nessa Wold booked Flintmere's annual gas visit for 9 Oct and instructed check only; no extra repair spend without asking her (events 5, 16, 23). Visit done 9 Oct, recorded satisfactory, boiler and cooker on the job card (events 9, 19, gas-portal-record.pdf). Flintmere has paused issuing signed paperwork while its quality desk reconciles an appliance installation detail, with no date (events 19, 21, 24). A lockout diagnostic would be a separate job (events 9, 19). Landlord has paid for the visit (event 16) but has not approved a diagnostic or any further charge (event 23). Tenant can give access after 21 Oct (event 22). File review due 18 Oct (event 24).
handover_note.conflicts: Portal and engineer say the check is satisfactory (events 9, 15, 19), but no signed certificate has been issued, and Flintmere is querying an installation detail, so the satisfactory outcome may not stand. The landlord's portal screenshot shows 'Customer document: Processing', so it is not the certificate, though the landlord offered it as the paperwork (event 12). The satisfactory outcome sits alongside repeated lockouts of a gas boiler that no one has diagnosed. The most recent valid certificate in the file is dated 16 Oct 2024 (event 2), so the property may have no current certificate (expiry not confirmed in the case).
handover_note.done: Sent the tenant an update (no commitment; says the paperwork is paused, the diagnostic is awaiting the landlord's decision, and gives gas emergency advice). Booked nothing. Authorised no spend. Did not treat the portal screenshot as the certificate.
handover_note.needed: Property manager to: (1) decide how to get the signed gas safety record from Flintmere and what the installation-detail query is, and whether the 2024 certificate is still in date; (2) put the lockout risk to the landlord and get her explicit decision or approval for a diagnostic, which Flintmere or another engineer could do after 21 Oct per the tenant's access offer; (3) tell the tenant what paperwork will be issued and when.
